lead.headline: Claim Gordon before 01:00 — and Achane is still starting
lead.deck: Out for the season and still in an RB slot. Tuten goes in; Gordon is tonight's claim.
lead.body: De'Von Achane tore his ACL and is out for the season, and at 18:18 he is still in AVIATO's starting lineup. That's why ESPN has you at 114.0 against Aye-Aye's 125.2. Start Bhayshul Tuten there and the lineup reaches 126.7. Claims process at 01:00 Wednesday Mexico City, overnight. Ollie Gordon II, who took Miami's backfield on Sunday, is the one claim worth making, with Achane as the drop, and AVIATO is first in the order. Three starters are questionable and none has practised: Josh Allen (knee contusion, Chao expects no missed time), Justin Jefferson (ankle, 'got close' to playing last Sunday) and Jalen Coker (quad, Bryce Young having his own knee imaged). Both WR fallbacks lock before Sunday's inactives, so Friday's report decides Jefferson. Week 3 was lost 103.8 to 140.6; the best lineup this roster had scored 137.9, and three of the gaps were injury exits.

cannotSee.label: Rival claims
cannotSee.body: ESPN returns only your own pending claims, and the file doesn't show whether yours is submitted. AVIATO is first in the order, so a submitted Gordon claim should win.

cannotSee.label: Practice
cannotSee.body: No Sunday team has practised for Week 4. Allen, Jefferson and Coker rest on Monday–Tuesday medical reporting. Wednesday is the first evidence.

cannotSee.label: Matchup sample
cannotSee.body: Grades use footballdb's points allowed through three games, scoring format not stated, and its QB table lists 31 teams. McLaurin, Monangai, Boston and Kamara face defences outside the pull and are dashed.

cannotSee.label: Jaylen Wright
cannotSee.body: Day-to-day and aiming for Week 4; OUT in the file. How Miami splits the work once he's back isn't knowable until Sunday.

cannotSee.label: Fallback kickoffs
cannotSee.body: lineup_check.py picks fallbacks by projection and ignores their kickoff. Two of its three Chem fallbacks are unusable this week; the brief corrects them by hand.
